title: Grand Canyon Vista, Vintage B&W Snapshot, 1960s Arizona Photo
location: Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona, USA
description: A classic vintage black-and-white square snapshot featuring a panoramic view across the Grand Canyon in Arizona. Taken from an upper rim lookout framed by evergreen foliage in the foreground, the image highlights the expansive geological layers, mesas, and rugged rock faces characteristic of the American Southwest. Such personal travel photos were popular keepsakes for post-WWII families exploring National Parks during the mid-century road trip boom.
